四環醫藥控股集團有限公司（「四環醫藥」或「本       Founded in 2001 and listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong
公司」，連同其附屬公司為「本集團」）   （ 股份代   Kong Limited in 2010, Sihuan Pharmaceutical Holdings Group Ltd. (“Sihuan

於香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市，是一家         (Stock Code: 00460.HK) is an international medical aesthetic and biopharmaceutical
以創新為引領，堅持創新驅動，擁有獨立領先         company led and driven by innovation, with a leading independent production,
的自主生產、研究與開發（「研發」）技術平台，       and research and development (“R&D”) technology platform, a rich global product
具備豐富的全球化產品管線和成熟卓越銷售體         pipeline and a mature and excellent sales system. Focusing on high-growth
系的國際化醫美及生物製藥企業。四環醫藥聚         therapeutic areas such as medical aesthetics, oncology, metabolism, diabetes,
焦醫美、腫瘤、代謝、糖尿病、心腦血管、現         cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, modern Chinese medicine and industrial hemp,
代中藥及工業大麻等高增長治療領域，一直秉         it adheres to its overall strategic objective of “Adhering to the full-speed promotion
承「堅持全速推進四環醫美及生物製藥雙輪驅動        of a two-wheeled strategy of Sihuan medical aesthetics and biopharmaceuticals” to
戰略」的整體戰略目標來打造中國領先的醫美及        build a leading medical aesthetics and biopharmaceutical enterprise in China.

「2022中國生物醫藥科技創新價值榜」旨在基於數據對生物醫藥創新之路及其未來發展方向有所導向和
指引。其中，小分子創新藥榜單主要聚焦具有小分子創新藥管線且研發進展相對領先的企業。本次軒
竹生物獲納入「最具成長性小分子創新藥企業TOP10」，充分展現了行業對於軒竹生物發展的高度認
可。
“Top 10 Most Growing Enterprises of Small Molecule Innovative Drugs (「最具成長性小分子創
新藥企業TOP10」)” in 2022 China Biomedical Technology Innovation Value List (2022中國生物
醫藥科技創新價值榜)
Xuanzhu Biopharm was ranked among the “Top 10 Most Growing Enterprises of Small Molecule
Innovative Drugs” (「最具成長性小分子創新藥企業TOP10」) in the “2022 China Biomedical
Technology Innovation Value List” (「2022中國生物醫藥科技創新價值榜」). The “2022 China

innovation and its future development based on data. Among them, the list of small molecule
innovative drugs mainly focuses on enterprises with small molecule innovative drug portfolio
and relatively advanced R&D progress. The inclusion of Xuanzhu Biopharm in the “Top 10 Most

其中獨角獸企業指成立時間不超過10年、估值超過10億美元的未上市創業公司。本次評選，福布斯中
國從2,000餘家創業公司中，篩選出74家中國的新晉獨角獸企業，軒竹生物位列其中。目前，中國產
業背景的獨角獸新勢力，正在以更快的速度走到舞台中央，而本次軒竹生物榮列榜單之中，也證實了
資本市場對軒竹生物高價值的認可。
“Forbes Chinese Unicorn Company (「福布斯中國獨角獸公司」)”
Xuanzhu Biopharm was granted “Forbes Chinese Unicorn Company” (「福布斯中國獨角獸公司」).
During the year, Forbes China launched the nascent unicorns list for the first time, of which unicorn
companies represented those unlisted startups established for no more than 10 years and their
valuation were more than USD1 billion. In this selection, Forbes China selected 74 emerging unicorn
companies in China from more than 2,000 startups, and Xuanzhu Biopharm was listed among them.
Currently, new unicorn companies with Chinese industrial background are taking center stage at a
faster pace, and the fact that Xuanzhu Biopharm is selected on the list confirms the capital market's
recognition of Xuanzhu Biopharm’s high value.

業」)”

（「政策」）並將至少每年審閱政策以確保其有效                 Code and will review the Policy at least annually to ensure its effectiveness. Having

           相同及容易理解的本公司資料（包                         timely access to balanced and understandable information about the
           括其財務表現、戰略目標及計劃、                         Company (including its financial performance, strategic goals and plans,

           方面使股東可在知情情況下行使權                         Shareholders to exercise their rights in an informed manner, and to
           力，另一方面也讓股東及投資人士                         allow Shareholders and the investment community to engage actively
           與本公司加強溝通。                               with the Company.

       聯營公司是集團擁有一般不少於                       An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long-term interest of

       影響是參與被投資者的財務及經營                      the power to participate in the financial and operating policy decisions

       擁有共同控制權的訂約方據此對合                      have joint control of the arrangement have rights to the net assets of

       控制指按照合約協定對一項安排所                      control of an arrangement, which exists only when decisions about the

       動要求享有控制權之訂約方作出一                      control.

  2.7 公平值計量                            2.7 Fair value measurement
    本集團於各報告期末按公平值計量                        The Group measures certain financial instruments at fair value at the
    若干金融工具。公平值為市場參與                        end of each reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be
    者於計量日在有序交易中出售資產                        received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly
    所收取之價格或轉讓負債所支付之                        transaction between market participants at the measurement date.
    價格。公平值計量乃根據假設出售                        The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the
    資產或轉讓負債之交易在資產或負                        transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either
    債之主要市場或（在無主要市場之                        in the principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of
    情況下）在資產或負債之最具優勢                        a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset
    市場進行而作出。主要或最具優勢                        or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must be
    市場必須為本集團可進入之市場。                        accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is
    資產或負債之公平值乃按假設市場                        measured using the assumptions that market participants would use
    參與者於資產或負債定價時會以最                        when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act
    佳經濟利益行事計量。                             in their economic best interest.

      2.7 公平值計量（續）                            2.7 Fair value measurement (continued)
            非金融資產之公平值計量經計及市                       A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account
            場參與者透過以最大限度利用資產                       a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using
            以達致最佳用途或將資產出售予將                       the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market
            以最大限度利用資產以達致最佳用                       participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.
            途之另一名市場參與者而產生經濟
            效益之能力。


            本集團使用在屬適當情況下且具備                       The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the
            充足數據可供計量公平值之估值方                       circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure fair
            法，以盡量增加使用相關可觀察輸                       value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and minimising
            入數據及盡量減少使用不可觀察輸                       the use of unobservable inputs.
            入數據。

  2.15 金融資產減值                2.15 Impairment of financial assets
     本集團確認對並非按公平值計入損             The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses (“ECLs”)
     益的所有債務工具預期信用損失              for all debt instruments not held at fair value through profit or loss.
    （「預期信用損失」）的撥備。預期信            ECLs are based on the difference between the contractual cash flows
     用損失乃基於根據合約到期的合約             due in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows that the
     現金流量與本集團預期收取的所有             Group expects to receive, discounted at an approximation of the
     現金流量之間的差額而釐定，並以             original effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include cash
     原實際利率的近似值貼現。預期現             flows from the sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements that
     金流量將包括出售所持抵押的現金             are integral to the contractual terms.
     流量或組成合約條款的其他信貸提
     升措施。

    一般方法                         General approach
    預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就              ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which there
    自初始確認起未有顯著增加的信貸              has not been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition,
    風險而言，預期信貸虧損為未來12             ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from default events that
    個月內可能發生違約事件而導致的              are possible within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those
    信貸虧損（12個月預期信貸虧損）計            credit exposures for which there has been a significant increase in credit
    提撥備。就自初始確認起經已顯著              risk since initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit losses
    增加的信貸風險而言，不論何時發              expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of the

  (i)   由於醫藥行業的激烈競爭和本集團                 (i)   Due to the fierce competition within the pharmaceutical industry and
        資源的限制，本集團附屬公司管理                       the limitation of the Group’s resource, the management of the Group’s
        層考慮到若干項目的未來回報率                        subsidiary considered the future return rate of certain projects was low
        較低，決定停止上述項目的進一                        and decided to discontinue further development of the aforementioned
        步開發。因此，本集團確認了若                        projects. Accordingly, the Group recognised full impairment loss for the
        干在建工程的賬面價值悉數減值                        carrying values of certain construction in progress and an impairment
        虧損，以及截至二零二二年十二月                       loss amounting to RMB38,884,000 was recorded during the year ended
        三十一日止年度錄得減值虧損人民                       31 December 2022. This amount of impairment loss was assessed based
        幣38,884,000元。該減值虧損金額                  on the individual-asset level, and was not included in the impairment
        乃基於個別資產層面進行評估，不                       testing based on CGUs.

      （續）                                    EQUITY METHOD (continued)
      減值測試                                    Impairment testing
      管理層將聯營公司或合營企業各自確認                       The management recognised each associate or joint venture as one CGU for
      為一個現金產生單位以進行減值測試。                       impairment testing. The recoverable amount of the CGU has been determined
      現金產生單位的可收回款額按使用價值                       based on a value-in-use calculation using cash flow projections based on
      計算法釐定，該計算法乃基於管理層所                       financial budgets covering a fixed-year period approved by management.
      批准涵蓋固定年期的財政預算案採用現                       Cash flows beyond the fixed-year period are extrapolated using the estimated
      金流量預測計算。固定年期以後的現金                       growth rates stated below.
      流量則採用下述估計增長率進行推斷。


      計算於二零二二年十二月三十一日投資                       Assumptions were used in the value-in-use calculation of the investments at
      的使用價值時已採用假設。下文描述管                       31 December 2022. The following describes each key assumption on which
      理層在進行投資減值測試時對其現金流                       management has based its cash flow projections to undertake impairment
      量預測採用之各項主要假設：                           testing of investments:


      預測收益：管理層根據過往銷售業績釐                       Projected revenue: Management determined the projected revenue based on
      定預測收益，並就政策及經濟環境特定                       the historical sales performance, adjusted for forward-looking factors specific
      前瞻性因素作出調整。                              to the policy and economic environment.


      毛利率：管理層基於過往表現及對市場                       Gross profit margins: Management determined budgeted gross profit margins
      發展的預期釐定預算毛利率。                           based on past performance and their expectations of market development.


      增長率：所採用的平均增長率與行業報                       Growth rate: The average growth rates used are consistent with the forecasts
      告所載預測一致。                                included in industry reports.


      貼現率：所採用的貼現率為稅前，並反                       Discount rate: The discount rates used are before tax and reflect specific risks
      映相關單位的特定風險。在決定估計貼                       relating to the relevant units. When determining the estimated discount rate,
      現率時，本集團參考了若干同行業上市                       the Group used the key parameters by reference to certain companies of the
      公司的關鍵參數。                                same industry.


      年內，減值虧損約人民幣389,311,000元                 During the year, an impairment loss of approximately RMB389,311,000 was
      已於損益中確認。減值變動乃由於董事                       recognised in the profit or loss. The impairment changes are driven by the

42. 財務風險管理                        42. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT
  42.1 財務風險因素                        42.1 Financial risk factors
    本集團的業務活動承受多種財務風                      The Group’s activities expose it to a variety of financial risks: market
    險：市場風險（包括外幣風險、價                      risk (including foreign currency risk, price risk and interest rate risk),
